plan: Given my value of $31, I will bid just below it to maximize potential profit while avoiding overpayment. Bidding slightly less than my value, say $30.9, increases my chance of winning while ensuring I don't pay more than my value. This strategy considers rational opponents who will also bid near their values. A bid of $30.9 allows for a small profit margin if I win against slightly lower bids, optimizing my earnings by balancing risk and reward.

My value is $31. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly below my value to avoid overpaying. Rational bidders will not bid above their value. Aiming to bid around $30 optimizes chances of winning while minimizing potential loss. Given no history, I assume others bid close to their value.
